reason: Primary purpose is user-facing alerting for DSH sessions: it monitors session task completion and user-request points, then notifies through local audio, popup UI, and optional system notification, with no evidence of external integrations beyond local assets and browser notification mechanisms.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH 会话完成或需要用户确认时播放本地语音并展示页面提示条，在页面失焦时可发送系统通知，帮助用户及时获知任务状态。
summaries.en: This plugin alerts users in DSH when tasks finish or require user input by playing local sounds, showing an in-page popup, and issuing system notifications when needed.

capabilities: Plays bundled local WAV alerts for task completion or user-ask events
Displays an in-page top popup for task status prompts
Sends system notifications when the page is unfocused/minimized
Registers host-side static wav routes for playback assets

reasons.code: README explicitly describes voice alerts, popup message bar, and system notification behavior triggered by task completion or ask-user/approval moments.
README lists browser platform behavior including lost-focus/minimized system notification fallback and click-to-return action.
package.json defines this as a DSH web plugin with client injection and patch-based bundle registration, matching a notification-focused browser UI plugin.
